page.layout: One column of running dictionary text, full width; page number top left, running head top centre; catchword "Intus]" at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: quere, Cic. Torquere collum, Liv. Obtorquere collum alicui, Plin. Gulam, Cic. Retorquere, Plin. Iun. Prætorquere caput, Col. Replicare, Cato.
Intractabilis] Intactilis. Suffugit tactum manum, Lucr. Incontiguus tactu Deus, Arnob. Difficilis, morosus, durus & ferreus homo, Cic. Inflexibilis, Plin.

Intrare] Ingredi, inire domum, introire in, inferre pedem, Cic. Initare, Pacuv. Introgredi, Virg. Introitum facere, Col. Facere se intra limen, Apul. Subire tectum, Caes. Penetrare, penitus intrare, Fest. Penetrare se in, Gell. Succedere urbi, Virg. Invehitur victor in Capitolium, Cic.
Intricare] In tricas conjicere. Perplexari, Plaut. Solvas quod male implicuisti, Sen.

Intricatum negotium] Contorta oratio. Contortulae conclusiunculae, inextricabilis, inenodabilis, Cic. Pertricosus, Mart. Inexplicabilis error, Plin. Res involutissimae, Sen. Nec caput, nec pedes habet. Labyrintho intricatior. Vid. Perplexus.
Introducere] Inducere personam: novum verbum in linguam, Cic. Isocratem Plato facit laudari à Socrate, Id.
Introitus] Ingressio, Cic. Ingressus, Quint. Initus, Lucr. Ephodos, Firm.
Introrsum] Intro ferre, Cic. Interius pergens, Amm. Introrsus, Varr. Intra tecta vocare, Virg. Intus compellere, Cels.
Intrudere aliquid] Infulcire, Sen. Detrudere. Detrudi ac compingi in pistrinum, Cic.
Intumescere] Invaserunt misero in genua flemina, Plaut. Intumuit caput, Ovid. Obturgescit pes, Lucr. Tumere, Plaut. Obturgere, Lucil. Inflari, Cic. Extumescere. Extuberat aliquid, Plin.
Inturbatus] Inturbidus, Tac. Imperturbato, ore bibit venenum, Ovid.

page.notes: Catchword "Intus]" is printed at bottom right; the final line also carries a catchword-like entry. Small faded text at the bottom left and a dark spot at left edge are not transcribed. Some words in the margins are show-through and omitted.
